strategies.name: EMA trend following
strategies.idea: Hold the market in whichever direction it is already moving.
strategies.buy: Close above EMA 100.
strategies.exit: Reversed by the opposite signal, or the trailing stop.
strategies.notes: EMA 100 is the conventional medium-term trend average.

strategies.name: EMA + RSI pullback
strategies.idea: Buy a dip inside an established uptrend.
strategies.buy: Context: close above EMA 200, EMA 50 above EMA 200, RSI above 52. Entry: price touches the EMA 20/50 band, RSI dipped below 45 within 10 bars, RSI crosses above 50, candle closes up.
strategies.exit: Stop or target only; the rule defines no exit of its own.
strategies.notes: Thresholds are the specification's; the 2/3 ATR bracket is the conventional 1:1.5 risk-reward.

strategies.name: EMA + RSI + ATR risk management
strategies.idea: The same pullback, but the position is closed when the entry timeframe loses its trend rather than at a fixed target.
strategies.buy: Context: close above EMA 200, EMA 50 above EMA 200, EMA 200 rising, RSI above 50. Entry: pullback into the EMA zone, RSI dip below 45, RSI crosses above 50, bullish close.
strategies.exit: Close below EMA 50 with RSI below 45.
strategies.notes: The stop is placed by the rule at the most recent swing low, so it adapts to the setup rather than to a fixed distance.

strategies.name: Multi-timeframe EMA trend
strategies.idea: Trade only when three timeframes agree on direction.
strategies.buy: All three timeframes printing an up bar.
strategies.sell: All three printing a down bar (short).
strategies.exit: Timeframes disagree, or the trailing stop.
strategies.notes: The 1/2/4 spacing keeps all three timeframes within the available history.

strategies.name: EMA crossover + RSI confirmation
strategies.idea: Trade the EMA pair, but only when momentum and a candlestick pattern agree.
strategies.buy: Price above EMA 20, EMA 20 above EMA 50, RSI above 50, bullish pattern.
strategies.exit: Reversed by the opposite signal, or the stop/target.
strategies.notes: The project's original rule, included as a baseline.

strategies.name: Trend regime filter
strategies.idea: Own the market while it is above its long average, stand aside below it.
strategies.buy: Close above SMA 200.
strategies.exit: Close below SMA 200.
strategies.notes: A participation rule rather than a trading rule; included because it is the simplest thing that can beat holding, by being absent during declines.

strategies.name: Breakout + trend filter (four regime)
strategies.idea: Classify the market into four states and use the playbook each deserves.
strategies.indicators: EMA 8, EMA 14, EMA 200, ADX 14, ATR 14, RSI 14
strategies.buy: Regime 1: aligned rising uptrend with ADX above 20, entered on a pullback. Regime 2: a new 20-bar high with ATR expanding.
strategies.sell: None - long only. Regimes 3 (ADX low) and 4 (downtrend) stay in cash.
strategies.exit: Trailing stop; regime 4 blocks new entries.
strategies.notes: ADX 20 is the conventional threshold between trend and range.

strategies.name: Donchian breakout
strategies.idea: Buy a new N-bar high, leave on a new M-bar low.
strategies.buy: Close above the 55-bar high.
strategies.exit: The opposite channel break.
strategies.notes: 55/20 are the original Turtle parameters, not tuned here.

strategies.name: Mean reversion + RSI
strategies.idea: Fade a stretch away from the average instead of following it.
strategies.buy: Close 2.5 standard deviations below the average.
strategies.sell: Close 2.5 standard deviations above the average (short).
strategies.exit: Price returns within 0.5 deviations of the average.
strategies.notes: Included as the opposite hypothesis to the eight trend rules above.

strategies.name: ATR-managed trend (master)
strategies.idea: A strict multi-condition trend filter with staged stop management.
strategies.buy: Context: EMA 8 > EMA 14 > EMA 200, close above EMA 200, RSI above 50. Entry: pullback into the EMA 8/14 zone, RSI dip below 45, RSI crosses above 50, bullish candle closing above EMA 8.
strategies.exit: Close below EMA 14 with RSI below 45, or the context breaking.
strategies.trail: 2 x ATR, activated once 2 ATR in profit; stop to breakeven at 1 ATR
strategies.notes: Every number here is the specification's own.
